## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Arabic and English are welcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant Arabic/English and RTL/LTR behavior was checked.
- [ ] Scene changes were checked in preview and exported video, when applicable.
- [ ] No private media, credentials, build output or dependency caches are included.

Include screenshots for visible changes and export settings for rendering changes.
